Pulling up to a stop he hauled himself out of the vehicle and sighed. Sudden presence of light made her pupils betray her as they sharply contracted, her subterfuge was good but biology still ruled supreme.

"Come on 'lil darlin'," he murmured, reaching out.

Suddenly her entire body tensed, the sensation of soft, alien skin against her scales was probably just as terrifying as her ordeal. Experience with his own daughter had taught him not to rush physical contact, her kind was apt to bite at the slightest provocation, so he gently eased himself closed and pried away her little cocoon of fabric. Initially she resisted the action, but familiar voices in the distance made her perk up with a startled huff; her nostrils flared wide to take in the breeze.

"Let's go find your momma, okay?"

When she looked up at him his heart fluttered, his face lit up all by itself with the warm smile that came with being a father. Even so she was reluctant, but after the initial hesitation she sprang to him and latched on tightly. Lifting her was a hell of a lot harder than he had anticipated, despite her young age and small frame she weighed far more than the estimation he had. Adrenaline was funny like that, when he carried her before she felt as light as a feather. Of course he knew the reason why her little body was so dense; against his torso he could feel that the kid was ripped just like the rest of her species.

Well, except for some.

Ahead he could see a familiar flash of purple accompanied by a corpulent mass, she was easily as big as Khojaewa and despite the ridiculous girth she carried herself like she was made of steel. Her gray-blue scales were quite similar to the girl's, her underside was splashed with a patch of creamy white that ran from under her jaw and down to the inside of her thighs. Much like the rest of her species she had strong facial features, her long snout was both feminine and graceful but also thick and obviously built to take a beating. Just like his lover she had thick scales running from halfway up her snout to the top of her head and they were flared in a way that only indicated anger.

She also could scowl, her kind were no different than most other species in the galaxy, the ridges above her eyes were as expressive as his own eyebrows and her lips curled in a familiar way to display her top teeth. Next to her Inzili seemed unnaturally small, her expression was worry and panic.

When the giant lizard grunted out a command Inzili looked like she was about to lose it. Fortunately the girl sprang free from his grasp and bolted for the pair, and with an excited vault she threw herself into the giant's waiting embrace.

"Oh Teekus!" Inzili sobbed, rushing to him to smother him in affection and she finished it with a frantic, slopping kiss.

There was a lot more tongue than he was comfortable with, but he relaxed in her grip and returned the embrace with a gentle, one-armed squeeze. Before he had trouble breathing she let him go and looked him over, he was bloody and filthy but still mostly in one piece. There was that wound though...

"Let me see this, how happen?" she asked, confiscating his arm to examine. "Wah! Teekus! This not good..."

"Darlin' I think I'm gonna need a hand fixin' it up."

Before he asked she gave him an irritated look before muttering, "of course I fix, don't be dumb."

Stan grinned and gave her a loving peck. "I love you too."

With a shake of her head she led him by his uninjured arm and sat him down next to the medical kit she had torn apart. Fortunately the villagers had a thing for field stone retaining walls and raised terraces, so he could lay back against the flat stones and relax which suited her just fine. A lifetime ago when she was new to slavery they had made her a medical assistant for some unexplained reason, perhaps as yet another sick joke by those racist fucking smoothskins. She came to them scarred and disfigured, they named her "Kicks" for almost "kicking the bucket" and laughed every time it came up. Still, she learned a valuable skill and she did enjoy training because it didn't have regular beatings and rapes as extracurricular activities.

"Better medic than I am," he chuckled.

"You good at other things, my love," she cooed, giving his hand a gentle kiss, "we make good team, you get hurt and I fix you. Then fuck you."

He laughed and closed his eyes. "Oh I reckon that last part causes the other two prolly most the time."

"Hmmm! I think you right," she giggled, not regretting it one bit.

Shifting her attention back to where it belonged she used the tiny needle on his waiting flesh, humming softly as she repaired her mate. Stan was a professional, he knew how to stabilize combat injuries and to keep the wounded alive but he was not a doctor.
